summary: Canadian Solar Inc. filed a Form 6-K to furnish the first-quarter report of its majority-owned subsidiary, CSI Solar Co., Ltd., which is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's Sci-Tech Innovation Board. Canadian Solar owns approximately 64% of CSI Solar. The filing is a routine quarterly report disclosing financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026, including operating revenue of RMB 7.13 billion and net profit of RMB 519 million. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is described. This is a standard earnings release, not a special situation.
